name: eaa-tuktuk-system
description: EAA Airport Tuk-Tuk Digital Taxi System - Microservices Architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:services"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:booking" "npm run dev:driver" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:location" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: for dir in services/*; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:services
scripts.build:services: for dir in services/*; do (cd "$dir" && npm run build); done
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:services: for dir in services/*; do (cd "$dir" && npm test); done
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate:auth && npm run migrate:booking && npm run migrate:driver && npm run migrate:payment

author: EAA Development Team
